questions.question: What percentage is Landon Donovan's overall rating higher than Jordan Bowery on 2013/7/12?
questions.evidence: Landon Donovan's refers to fld043 = 'Landon Donovan'; Jordan Bowery refers to fld043 = 'Jordan Bowery'; percentage refers to DIVIDE(SUBTRACT(fld043 = 'Landon Donovan' fld005; fld043 = 'Jordan Bowery' fld005), fld043 = 'Landon Donovan' fld005)*100
questions.SQL: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Landon Donovan' THEN t2.fld005 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 - SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN t2.fld005 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Landon Donovan' THEN t2.fld005 ELSE 0 END) AS LvsJ_percent FROM tab02 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS t2 ON t1.fld002 = t2.fld002 WHERE SUBSTRING(t2.fld004, 1, 10) = '2013-07-12'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 - SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) LvsJ_percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_fifa_api_id = t2.player_fifa_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t2.`date`, 1, 10) = '2013-07-12'

questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT t4.fld051 FROM tab06 AS t3 INNER JOIN tab05 AS t4 ON t3.fld049 = t4.fld049 WHERE SUBSTRING(t3.fld004, 1, 4) = '2012' AND t3.fld057 > (SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.fld057) AS REAL) / COUNT(t1.fld001) FROM tab05 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab06 AS t2 ON t1.fld049 = t2.fld049 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t2.fld004) = '2012')

questions.question: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?
questions.evidence: finishing rate refers to finishing; highest average finishing rate = MAX(AVG(fld011)); highest football player refers to MAX(fld045); shortest football player refers to MIN(fld045);
questions.SQL: SELECT A FROM (SELECT AVG(fld011) AS result, 'Max' AS A FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld003 = T2.fld003 WHERE T1.fld045 = (SELECT MAX(fld045) FROM tab02) UNION SELECT AVG(fld011) AS result, 'Min' AS A FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld003 = T2.fld003 WHERE T1.fld045 = (SELECT MIN(fld045) FROM tab02)) ORDER BY result DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT A FROM ( SELECT AVG(finishing) result, 'Max' A FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.height = ( SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player ) UNION SELECT AVG(finishing) result, 'Min' A FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.height = ( SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player ) ) ORDER BY result DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question:
What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Diallo and Aaron Appindangoye
?
questions.evidence: difference of the average ball control = SUBTRACT(AVG(fld019 WHERE fld043 = 'Abdou Diallo'), AVG(fld019 WHERE fld043 = 'Aaron Appindangoye')); AVG(fld019 WHERE fld043 = 'XX XX') = SUM(CASE WHEN fld043 = 'XX XX' THEN fld019 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN fld043 = 'XX XX' THEN id ELSE NULL END)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.fld019 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.fld001 ELSE NULL END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.fld019 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.fld043 = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.fld001 ELSE NULL END) FROM tab02 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS t2 ON t1.fld003 = t2.fld003
